_pushed: Pushed into the Global Question Class 334437 on 2026-09-01, block 0-3-4-1, gradebook category GROUP. RENUMBERED from CPM to book chapters (Steve, 2026-09-01): CPM 5=book 4, 6=5, 7=6, 8=7, 9=8, per _cpm_spine.md in bookSHelf. Undated; hw template 23258795 supplied the settings and the category was set on top of it. Questions attached by qsetid in manifest order, per-question points replayed through itemarray[i][4]+submitChanges(), then question GROUPS rebuilt with groupSelected() highest-index-first (grouping renumbers the rows behind it). Read back with the exact question count, the exact group count and the exact points total. NOTE: a group scores ONCE, so the points total is below the question count wherever groups are used.
